description: This source file implements the advanced interface functions for the Slap Access Manager Object, managing proxy object access, creation, registration, unbinding, and verification within a service logic aggregation system.

classes.name: SLAP_ACCESS_MANAGER_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the Access Manager Object managing proxy creation and access within the SLAP framework.

classes.name: PSLAP_GOA_INTERFACE
classes.description: Interface for the Global Object Access component.

classes.name: PSLAP_POA_INTERFACE
classes.description: Interface for the Proxy Object Access component.

classes.name: PSLAP_ENV_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Environment controller handling context-specific SLAP interface retrieval.

classes.name: PSLAP_UOA_INTERFACE
classes.description: Interface for User Object Access, managing proxy object lifecycle operations.

classes.name: PSLAP_SRV_PROXY_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents a runtime Service Proxy Object within the SLAP architecture.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapAmoPoaAcqObjectAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name)
methods.description: Acquires access to a runtime service proxy object based on the provided object name.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoPoaRelObjectAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapObject)
methods.description: Releases the previously acquired service proxy object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapAmoPoaCreateProxyObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name,ANSC_HANDLE hSlapGoaObj)
methods.description: Creates a new runtime service proxy object associated with a specific object name and GOA object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoPoaEnrollProxyObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hObjDescr)
methods.description: Registers an object descriptor with the UOA interface.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapAmoPoaUnbindProxyObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name)
methods.description: Unbinds an object descriptor identified by object name.

methods.name: BOOL SlapAmoPoaVerifyProxyObject(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * obj_name)
methods.description: Verifies the existence or validity of a proxy object by name.
